name: nav
description: A bar with a brand, a list of links, and actions, that collapses the links behind a toggle at its own width and opens them as a sheet, a drawer, or a screen.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: The nav's own width at or above which the links sit in the bar; below it they are behind the toggle.

attributes.name: data-panel
attributes.description: The shape of the open list below the threshold: a sheet under the bar, a drawer from the start edge, or the whole screen.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the current link and of the hover tint.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between the bar's parts and between the links.

children.description: The site's name or mark, usually a link home.
The toggle; its popovertarget names the list's id. Hidden while the links are in the bar.
The links, one per li, with role="list" and the id the toggle names.
An entry in the list; each holds one link.
An li holding a button with popovertargetaction="hide", shown at the panel's top end corner and hidden in the bar. Required with data-panel="screen".
Buttons at the end of the bar.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-padding
tokens.description: Padding of the bar and of the open panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-radius
tokens.description: Corner of the links and the toggle.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-border
tokens.description: The bar's bottom edge, and the sheet's.

tokens.name: --yeti-control-size
tokens.description: Minimum height of the bar, the toggle, and each link.

keyboard.action: On the toggle, opens or closes the list.
From the toggle, into the open list's first link.
Closes the open list and returns focus to the toggle.

a11y.notes: Give the nav an aria-label, since a page often has more than one. The toggle needs a name (aria-label or visible text); the browser sets its expanded state. Mark the current page's link with aria-current="page". Put role="list" on the ul, because the reset only removes list markers where that role says the list is decorative. With data-panel="screen" there is no outside to click, so include the close item.

guarded: anchor positioning with anchor-scope (fallback: the sheet starts at the top of the viewport)
